notes: Fixes the crash on open in v3.9.0/v3.9.1. Confirmed cause: the new design's window styling touched the window insets controller before the window existed (NullPointerException in Mx.mxChrome during ShellActivity.onCreate). The styling now applies once the window is ready and can never crash startup. Also new: a built-in crash recorder - if the app ever fails at startup again, it shows the exact error on the next open instead of dying silently. Includes everything from v3.9.1, including your own launcher icon on white. Known gap: Settings still uses the previous theme (re-skin to follow); the Solar panel is an honest empty state until the Universe feed exists.
